_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The status readout's cwd segment moves the conversation, and tells the agent. The screen is 1280x800. The conversation's directory is {{CWD}}; {{TARGET}} is another, small directory (shown as {{TARGET_LABEL}}). Call "cwd" returns the conversation's working directory as the server has it. "The segment" is the first visible ".status-readout-cwd"; "the path" is its ".status-readout-cwd-path"; "the panel" is ".modal.directory-picker-modal". Accessible names: an element's name is its aria-label if it has one; otherwise a button's name is its text with whitespace collapsed and trimmed, leaving out aria-hidden parts, and a dialog's name is the text of the element its aria-labelledby refers to; "named X" means the name is exactly X. Only elements that are not display: none count. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The segment should be visible (allow 30s), and the path visible with exactly the text "{{CWD}}". 3. Click the segment: the panel should be visible. 4. Fill the panel's ".directory-picker-input" with "{{TARGET}}/": the panel's ".directory-picker-current-path" should contain "e2e". 5. Click the button in the panel's ".modal-footer" whose accessible name contains "Select": the panel should be hidden. 6. The path should have exactly the text "{{TARGET_LABEL}}" (allow 15s). 7. Call "cwd" until it returns "{{TARGET}}" (up to 15s). 8. The last data-testid "message-cwdchange" should be visible and contain "working directory" and "{{TARGET_LABEL}}". 9. There must be no '[data-testid="message"].message-user' containing "{{TARGET}}" (count 0): the notice is not shown as something the user said.

steps.expression: (() => { const n = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="message-cwdchange"]')].at(-1); if (!n || !n.checkVisibility()) return 'no visible notice'; return [n.textContent.includes('working directory'), n.textContent.includes('{{TARGET_LABEL}}')].join(' '); })()
